crossRefs.note: But he answered them, “You see all of these things, don’t you? Most certainly I tell you, there will not be left here…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Moreover, if he has gone into a city, then all Israel will bring ropes to that city, and we will draw it into the river, until there isn’t one small stone found there.”
translations.bsb: If he retreats to a city, all Israel will bring ropes to that city, and we will drag it down to the valley until not even a pebble can be found there.”
translations.kjv: Moreover, if he be gotten into a city, then shall all Israel bring ropes to that city, and we will draw it into the river, until there be not one small stone found there.
translations.asv: Moreover, if he be gotten into a city, then shall all Israel bring ropes to that city, and we will draw it into the river, until there be not one small stone found there.
